name: CnfLabShapedTestCodeSystem
title: CNF test code system, LOINC-shaped (synthetic)
description: SYNTHETIC test content. A flat code system whose codes are SHAPED like LOINC observation codes (NNNNN-N) so the conformance battery can drive a SECOND terminology namespace, routed to a second configured provider, in one running deployment. It contains no LOINC content and is not derived from any licensed terminology: every code and display is invented for this test corpus and lives under the reserved example.test domain (IETF RFC 6761 §6.2).
